assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single 3:2 landscape environment plate, 1536 by 1024, for a portrait mobile department management game. Primary request: an intimate department command room at blue hour, illustrated as a physical place that tells the story of patient, practical work. An oval worn wood briefing table sits toward the foreground with an unlabelled paper street plan, four restrained folders and a small radio; behind it are two compact dispatch desks and an ordinary wall pinboard holding abstract pale sheets. Tall windows reveal the same blue-hour city and leafy street as a modest modern municipal station. Empty chairs, lamps on, no people. Style: polished hand-painted editorial game illustration, architectural forms with broad readable silhouettes, subtle dry brush texture, slightly simplified materials, no hard outlines, no photorealistic lens effects. Restrained cobalt dusk, deep navy and slate, warm amber lamps, muted ivory paper; calm and humane, not heroic. Composition: eye-level three-quarter room view, table as one clear central form, windows on upper half, dark quiet foreground corners where a UI can place small live state markers, no text integrated into the painting. Avoid text, lettering, numerals, logos, badges, flags, insignia, firearms, weapons, surveillance walls, tactical poses, neon, sci-fi HUDs, coins, particles, sparkle effects, dramatic action and ornamental clutter.
assets.placement_note: Briefing table, paper plan and radio establish decisions and dispatch. Place current call or readiness status in the lower foreground; illustration is environmental, not a live map.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single 3:2 landscape environment plate, 1536 by 1024, for a portrait mobile department management game. Behind the workbench a dark workshop window shows cobalt dusk and a leafy city street; one warm adjustable task lamp illuminates the model. No people.
